acquisition_policy.reason: No catalog component has completed asset inspection, normalization, eligibility and named admission; bulk downloads are outside this preparation profile.

entries.terms_note: Only declared train splits may enter method training; benchmark remains evaluation-only. Public profiles never become the real user identity.
Noncommercial card; reserve whole persona histories and chronological variants.
Reserve questions and supporting histories; never use answers as memory observations.
Version differs from cleaned release; do not pool overlapping histories as independent evidence.
ODC-BY collection terms do not replace component terms. Pinned metadata reports 939343 rows.
Approximately 1.2M completions from 75k questions; group all sibling completions. Check answers independently before use.
Preference scores are teacher judgments, not independently verified facts.
Replay tool traces against a sandbox and actual executable contracts; transcript success is insufficient.
Pin benchmark version and evaluator; do not train on its reference calls.
Card license other; inherited source terms and research-purpose image bundle restriction require resolution.
CC-BY card, COCO asset and generation/provider terms all apply; questions sharing an image stay together.
No blanket collection license; overlapping components must not be counted or split twice.
MIT card does not settle source asset terms; images configuration only initially, do not duplicate its PDFs. Full images download is about 159.4GB.
Multi-terabyte collection; sample eligible components only. Avoid duplicating Cauldron and individual source datasets.
Resolve original VQA and image terms, split by image and related derivatives before questions.
Mirror GPL-3.0 label is not proof of rights for every chart; review original data. Use tables only as verifier data unless an oracle arm is declared.
Original dataset access/terms must be respected despite mirror availability; no blanket license recorded.
All testmini/test records reserved; testmini is not a training set. Source images may have component terms.
Dev examples remain few-shot/evaluation material, not added to SFT. Component image terms require review.
CC-BY-NC-4.0 card; 83132 pairs; preference ranking is not visual truth. Decontaminate COCO/TextVQA overlap.
Per-component terms; use verifiable constraints/code subsets and record source mixture.
ODC-BY collection plus original source conditions; large CPT is outside the first V0/V1 campaign.
Dataset and generator source located; procedural temporal extension is a new proposed corpus.
Choose balanced train subset; full question variants are not independent samples.
Official source located; guessed mirror returned HTTP401. No mirror contents verified.
Pin OCRBench or OCRBench_v2 explicitly; guessed Hub mirror returned HTTP401.
Ten conversation clusters do not provide hundreds of independent users.
Method benchmark, not authentic identity data; preserve all user-profile boundaries.
Some questions have no image; lecture/solution fields are labels, not inference input.
Random and zero-shot splits share underlying examples; balance true/false and reference frames.
Question regimes are not independent image sets; keep COCO overlap out of promotion claims.
Executable constraints measure instruction compliance, not semantic truth.
Execute generated code only in bounded isolated evaluation; benchmark solutions are not practice data.
500 engineer-confirmed cases; costly container evaluation deferred beyond initial vision alignment.
